findings: RG-201 HIGH PACKAGE_INTEGRITY — docs/requirements/requirements-specification.md:3-22,342-360,554-578 identifies PRS-REQ-001 version 0.3 but still binds its content to OD-001 through OD-009 and the earlier repository baseline. Authoritative factoryctl decisions RG-101 through RG-106 were recorded later in .factory/decisions.json:11-65 and are absent from the specification and its traceability matrix. Read-only verification established the exact reviewed bytes, so this is a remediable specification defect rather than BLOCKED. Affected: entire package. Required action: issue a superseding package incorporating and tracing the recorded decisions, with current version, source-set identity, digest, revision, and status. Owner: requirements-specification-agent. Disposition: prevents PASS.

RG-202 HIGH AMBIGUOUS_REQUIREMENT — docs/requirements/requirements-specification.md:131,160-180,298-325 and 427-471; affected FR-024, FR-025, FR-028, FR-032, FR-037, FR-038, FR-042, FR-043 and their acceptance criteria. These statements still use undefined valid-update and valid-transition predicates and omit authoritative initial states, transition matrices, and mutability rules recorded by RG-101 in .factory/decisions.json:12-17. Architecture would still lack the test oracle for lifecycle and immutable-field behavior. Owner: requirements-specification-agent. Disposition: prevents architecture readiness.

RG-203 HIGH MISSING_AUDIT_REQUIREMENT — docs/requirements/requirements-specification.md:129,150,230,290,399-415; affected BR-021, FR-014, SR-005, AC-022. The package does not incorporate RG-102 from .factory/decisions.json:20-25: V1 decryption evidence is structured application/security logging only, must be emitted before plaintext is returned, and logging failure must withhold plaintext. The log ownership and explicit no-audit-storage boundary are also not traced. Owner: requirements-specification-agent. Disposition: prevents safe architecture of decryption.

RG-204 HIGH UNTESTABLE_REQUIREMENT — docs/requirements/requirements-specification.md:209,227-229,279,312-315; affected DR-004, SR-002, SR-004, AC-010, AC-044 through AC-047. The package still refers to a safe or approved mask without incorporating the exact normalized-value masking algorithm approved by RG-103 in .factory/decisions.json:28-33. Sensitive-data disclosure therefore lacks an objective test oracle. Owner: requirements-specification-agent. Disposition: prevents PASS.

RG-205 HIGH REQUIREMENT_CONFLICT — docs/requirements/requirements-specification.md:146,192,298,436,479; affected FR-010, VR-008, AC-030. VR-008 states that no general client-command idempotency obligation is approved, while RG-104 in .factory/decisions.json:36-41 mandates tenant-and-operation-scoped Idempotency-Key behavior for Party creation, including replay, concurrent duplicate convergence, payload conflict, HTTP 409, and duplicate-side-effect prohibition. No requirement, acceptance criterion, or validation mapping represents that authoritative decision. Owner: requirements-specification-agent. Disposition: prevents architecture readiness and must remain visible for later database-contract validation.

RG-206 HIGH MISSING_REQUIREMENT — docs/requirements/requirements-specification.md:98,115,141,187,197,431,444,474; affected BR-007, FR-005, FR-018, VR-003, VR-013. The package omits RG-105 from .factory/decisions.json:44-49, which assigns ownership of the versioned normalizer/validator catalog to application code and defines unsupported-key rejection, release governance, non-removal of referenced implementations, readiness failure, and fail-unchanged behavior. Owner: requirements-specification-agent. Disposition: prevents architecture readiness.

RG-207 HIGH REQUIREMENT_CONFLICT — docs/requirements/requirements-specification.md:199-202,331-334,408-415,482-489; affected VR-015 through VR-018 and AC-063 through AC-066. The traceability matrix still cites prior gate finding RG-005 as authority. More materially, VR-016 and AC-064 can place an event that cannot be published into FAILED without distinguishing transient publication failure, while RG-106 in .factory/decisions.json:52-57 requires transient RabbitMQ/network failures to retain PENDING eligibility and reserves FAILED for non-recoverable serialization or publication errors. Authorized recovery of the same event and the no-purge boundary are not fully incorporated. Owner: requirements-specification-agent. Disposition: prevents PASS.

RG-208 MEDIUM MISSING_REQUIREMENT — docs/requirements/requirements-specification.md:159,167,172,177,191,222,296,301,309,315,321; affected FR-023, FR-031, FR-036, FR-041, VR-007, IR-005. Paginated searches and stable errors remain undefined for supported filters, sorting guarantees, page defaults and limits, and stable error categories beyond selected HTTP cases. Owner: requirements-specification-agent. Disposition: requires specification correction before downstream API-contract approval.
requiredActions: Publish a superseding identifiable requirements package that incorporates factoryctl-recorded RG-101 through RG-106 and updates its version, digest procedure, repository revision, source manifest, approval status, supersession record, and traceability.

Replace undefined lifecycle and update predicates with the approved initial states, complete transition matrices, immutable fields, and mutable-field boundaries, with observable positive and negative acceptance criteria.
Specify the approved V1 structured-log-only decryption audit boundary, mandatory fields, plaintext prohibition, emit-before-return ordering, and fail-closed logging-failure behavior.
Specify and test the approved normalized-identifier masking algorithm for lengths above and at or below four characters.

Add Party-creation idempotency requirements and acceptance criteria covering key scope, same-payload replay, different-payload conflict, concurrent duplicates, deterministic result, and duplicate mutation/outbox prohibition.
Add requirements and acceptance criteria for ownership, release governance, validation, readiness, and failure behavior of normalizer and validator implementation keys.
Correct outbox failure classification and traceability to RG-106, distinguishing transient PENDING retry eligibility from non-recoverable FAILED outcomes and defining authorized same-event recovery.
Define requirements-level pagination, filtering, sorting, limits, defaults, and stable error categories without prematurely designing the OpenAPI contract.
